verses.text: “Na true I dey tell una, di one wey no enter by di door enter di sheep fold, but climb up another way, na thief and robber.
But di one wey enter by di door na di shepherd of di sheep.
Di gatekeeper dey open di door for am, and di sheep dey hear im voice. E dey call im own sheep by name, and dey lead dem out.
Any time e bring out im own sheep, e dey go before dem, and di sheep dey follow am, because dem know im voice.
Dem no go follow stranger at all, but dem go run from am; because dem no know di voice of strangers.”
Jesus talk this parable to dem, but dem no understand wetin e dey tell dem.
So Jesus talk to dem again, “Na true I dey tell una, I be di door of di sheep.
All wey come before me na thieves and robbers, but di sheep no listen to dem.
I be di door. If anybody enter by me, e go dey saved, and e go go in and go out, and e go find pasture.
Di thief dey come only to steal, kill, and destroy. I come so that dem go get life, and get am plenty.
I be di good shepherd. Di good shepherd dey lay down im life for di sheep.
Di one wey be hired hand, no be shepherd, wey no own di sheep, dey see wolf dey come, leave di sheep, run. Di wolf dey snatch di sheep, scatter dem.
Di hired hand dey run because e be hired hand, and e no care for di sheep.
I be di good shepherd. I know my own, and my own know me;
just as Papa God know me, and I know Papa God. I dey lay down my life for di sheep.
I get other sheep, wey no dey this fold. I must bring dem too, and dem go hear my voice. Dem go become one flock with one shepherd.
So Papa God love me, because I dey lay down my life, so that I go take am again.
Nobody dey take am from me, but I dey lay am down by myself. I get power to lay am down, and I get power to take am again. I receive this commandment from my Papa God.”
Division rise again among di Jews because of these words.
Plenty of dem talk say, “Evil spirit dey inside am, and e don mad! Why una dey listen to am?”
Others talk say, “These no be di words of person wey evil spirit dey control. Evil spirit fit open di eyes of di blind?”
Na di Feast of di Dedication for Jerusalem.
E be winter, and Jesus dey waka for di temple, for Solomon porch.
So di Jews gather round am, talk to am say, “How long you go keep us for suspense? If you na di Christ, tell us plainly.”
Jesus answer dem, “I tell una, and una no believe. Di works wey I dey do for my Papa God name, na dem dey testify about me.
But una no believe, because una no be my sheep, as I tell una.
My sheep dey hear my voice, and I know dem, and dem dey follow me.
I dey give dem life wey no dey end. Dem no go ever perish, and nobody go snatch dem from my hand.
My Papa God, wey give dem to me, greater pass all. Nobody fit snatch dem from my Papa God hand.
Me and Papa God na one.”
So di Jews pick stones again to stone am.
Jesus answer dem, “I don show una plenty good works from my Papa God. For which of those works una dey stone me?”
Di Jews answer am, “We no dey stone you for good work, but for blasphemy: because you, as man, dey make yourself God.”
Jesus answer dem, “No be say e dey write for una law, ‘I talk, una be gods’?
If e call dem gods, di people wey God word come to—and di Scripture no fit break—
una dey talk about di one wey Papa God make holy and send enter di world, ‘You dey blaspheme,’ because I talk, ‘I be God Pikin’?
If I no dey do di works of my Papa God, no believe me.
But if I dey do dem, even though una no believe me, believe di works; so that una go know and believe say Papa God dey inside me, and I dey inside Papa God.”
Dem try again to catch am, and e escape from dem hand.
E go again to di other side of Jordan to di place wia John dey baptize before, and e stay there.
Plenty come to am. Dem talk say, “John no do any sign, but everything wey John talk about this man na true.”
Plenty believe am there.
